prompt:
We're switching our order management service from its current database vendor to PostgreSQL. The codebase lives under src/main/resources/ (the config and mapper XML files) and I need the whole thing to actually work on the new database without runtime errors.

Specifically:
1. Update the database connection config in src/main/resources/application.yaml so it connects to PostgreSQL at db-host:5432/orderdb using the schema 'ecommerce'. Also fix any health-check query that won't work on PostgreSQL. The soft-delete toggle values in the ORM config also need to be expressed in a way PostgreSQL understands for bit-type columns.
2. Convert all the SQL in src/main/resources/mapper/OrderMapper.xml and src/main/resources/mapper/OrderDetailMapper.xml so they run correctly on PostgreSQL — there are date functions, null-handling functions, insert conflict strategies, multi-table update patterns, type casts, and bit-column comparisons that are incompatible with PostgreSQL and must all be fixed.
3. The GROUP BY query in OrderDetailMapper.xml that selects per-order aggregates will crash on PostgreSQL's strict standard compliance — fix it so all selected columns are either in the GROUP BY or properly aggregated.
4. Create a file named create_sequences.sql that sets up the auto-increment sequences for the orders and order_detail tables. The current maximum IDs in the production data are recorded in scripts/max_id_reference.txt — your sequences must start above those values to avoid primary key conflicts.
